items.q: What should you remember about **cico model critique**?
items.a: **Two behaviors (gluttony + sloth) imply personal fault; ignores that 250** cal of almonds ≠ 250 cal of HFCS soda metabolically. Protein, fat, and carb calories are not interchangeable; fiber changes the equation.

items.q: What should you remember about **perfact nutrition framework**?
items.a: **Protect liver / feed gut /** support brain. Ultra-processed sugar products fail all three → metabolic poison, not food.

items.q: What should you remember about **fructose metabolic toxicity**?
items.a: **~10% intestinal de novo lipogenesis; fructose "wants to** be fat." Uric acid from fructose metabolism inhibits mitochondria. Liquid sugar (soda, juice) delivers dose without satiety fiber.

items.q: What should you remember about **Insulin: growth vs burn**?
items.a: **Insulin promotes cell growth/storage; chronically high insulin** → insulin resistance, blocks leptin at hypothalamus/nucleus accumbens → "never full" despite adequate fat stores.

items.q: What should you remember about **sugar addiction brain circuits**?
items.a: **Non-fruit fructose downregulates dopamine receptors like** nicotine/cocaine; alters craving/satisfaction circuits. Cross-links pleasure pain balance and highly palatable food reset.

items.q: What should you remember about **leaky gut fructose inflammation**?
items.a: **Fructose increases intestinal permeability → liver** inflammation → systemic inflammation (CRP). Gut microbiome support: fiber, fermented foods, fasting windows.

items.q: What should you remember about **nova food classification**?
items.a: **NOVA groups 1–2 = real/minimally processed; 3–4** = ultra-processed pseudo foods engineered for overconsumption. Lustig advocates banning class 3–4 from public schools.

items.q: What should you remember about **personal responsibility public health**?
items.a: **Every major public-health debacle started as "personal health** issue" until society responded (tobacco, syphilis, TB). Sugar industry funded CHD research deflection (1960s JAMA analysis).

items.q: What should you remember about **food industry price elasticity**?
items.a: **Sugar is price-inelastic (~−0.7 to** −0.8); small price cuts spike consumption disproportionately — industry knows and exploits.

items.q: What should you remember about **Trans fats vs omega-3s**?
items.a: **Trans fats accumulate (no desaturase to break** trans bond); omega-3s stay intact for brain/heart. Meat/eggs/fish: quality and processing matter more than category bans.

items.q: What should you remember about **Stress → cortisol → inflammation → sugar craving**?
items.a: **Chronic cortisol is pro-inflammatory;** acute cortisol is anti-inflammatory. Stress eating reinforces the loop.

items.q: What should you remember about **artificial sweetener liver risk**?
items.a: **Non-caloric sweeteners may impair neural/metabolic sensitivity to** sugar (Cell Metabolism sucralose+carb study cited); diet soda drinkers can still show liver fat deposition.
